source_judgment_basis: Independent semantic inspection of the entire assigned original science package and governing primary evidence found no remaining material error, omission or unsupported consequential decision. Minor source-fidelity/locator and opportunity-depth limits are preserved. Hashes, source counts, critic agreement and native completion are not the scientific proof.

axes.name: Original obligations and negative constraints
axes.analysis: The complete original brief and exact frozen/revealed plan are preserved as authority. The final compares controlled settling/flow, a measured filter candidate, and source segregation/contained accepted collection, while retaining intermittent loads, variable residue inventory, labor and residual fate. It proposes a baseline and contained comparison with stops. Appearance, safety, authorization, solids harmlessness, dosing, operating work, invented composition/throughput, and a final disposal route are not inferred. Unknowns and the owner’s zero-discharge choice remain open. The staged-settling variation has less depth (L03); exact coverage and administrative unknowns are recorded separately below.

axes.name: Consequential source claims, applicability and exact conditions
axes.analysis: Independent primary checks support incomplete pre-chemical settling, combined-train attribution, membrane feed/history/fouling and cleaning burdens, source-reduction precedents, representative sampling, and method-specific total/filtered fractions. Units and subjects are kept distinct: mg/L TSS, NTU turbidity, minutes of settling, nm aperture, Da cutoff, and bar pressure are source-specific. No source supplies a workshop default, legal domain or removal estimate. S02 internal reporting and S10 fidelity defects are disclosed in the final; E13 corroborates the original scientific micron definition. Locator/source-quality/access limits do not establish a remaining material claim error.

axes.name: Useful unfamiliar discovery, competing/analogous methods, implementation/history and breadth
axes.analysis: Discovery supplies actual ceramic-factory/laboratory studies, operational studio precedents and municipal failure evidence. The useful unfamiliar content is incomplete pre-chemical capture; stable feed does not validate a workshop train; submicron/variable feed and cleaning can defeat membrane simplicity; prevention/reclaim creates a different operational choice. Factory/studio contexts are differentiated. The transfer inquiry requests influent, size/chemistry, peak and quiet flows, geometry, QA, operating changes, cleanouts, downtime, residual routes and labor, and recovers bucket dates/workload. Alternative breadth goes beyond a favorite device. No particular new deployment or software release history is invented. Serial settling depth is limited (L03), but core opportunity coverage is substantive rather than vacuous caution.

axes.name: Wrong criticism, corrections, rejections and exact dispositions
axes.analysis: All three specific critic issues and its positive coverage conclusion receive explicit final dispositions. The run-count ambiguity is real, with a minor incorrect draft locator. The CADDIS rendering criticism is valid as source fidelity; E13 prevents misclassifying it as a scientific-unit error. Timing uncertainty is appropriate within critic/reviser allowed inputs; this wider assessment has actual native receipts but still cannot equate occupancy with a completed research hour. The final does not falsely reject supported alternatives or follow a criticism into material scope reduction. Its “all covered” conclusion overstates uniform depth of staged settling (L03). Exact brief/plan coverage and the original rejection set are independently adjudicated below.

axes.name: Supported discovery→draft→critique→final meaning preservation
axes.analysis: The final preserves matched-feed reasoning, the quiet-week confound, the distinction between particles and dissolved chemistry, physical-treatment limitations, source segregation/containment, labor/residuals, transfer questions, owner decisions, and future-only validation. Its prose is self-contained for the requested proposal; source maps retain detailed study conditions and stable source identities. The absence of the discovery’s comparison table is not itself loss of the comparison: final paragraphs state benefit, failure and burdens. The two original reporting defects remain identifiable and their final qualifications are added without silently overwriting lineage. Some numerical implementation detail resides in the navigable map rather than final narrative; staged settling remains thin, not falsely proven.

axes.name: Meaningful proposed versus executed validation and oracle applicability
axes.analysis: The later design characterizes variable influent/outlet across workloads, records flow/material/task mix, uses suitable composites and separate grabs, screens matched aliquots, and compares contained work blocks with maintenance, capacity, breakthrough and receiving-route stops. These distinguish treatment effects from reduced load and visual improvement. TSS/turbidity/size oracles address particles; inventory-informed method-defined chemical fractions address chemistry; neither establishes discharge permission or solids classification. Lab/authority/receiver decisions are separate gates. Thresholds and sample burden remain external choices after useful investigation, not fabricated constants. Executed work is desk review only; no wet work, system, pilot, assay, local permission, receiving-facility approval, or performance validation is claimed. Literature checks and freeze hashes are not empirical oracles. Original per-source browsing extent is not independently logged.
